gap: No result ChatGPT got states Apple's per-model limits: iPhone 16 and 16 Pro peak at 22.5 W (Anker says 22 W on its A2933), iPhone Air at 20 W, iPhone 17e at 15 W, and iPhone 16e has no MagSafe (Anker lists it as not compatible). Only the iPhone 16 Plus, 16 Pro Max, 17, 17 Pro/Pro Max and 18 Pro/Pro Max reach 25 W, and Apple adds that with a USB-C accessory plugged in, wireless charging drops to 10 W on the 17 Pro/Pro Max and 7.5 W on every iPhone 16.
standout_why: Compared against Macworld's car-charger roundup (cited), mobileplustech (top-ranked result), MobileReviews Eh! (cited) and the ESR help page. Macworld and mobileplustech only say '25 W for iPhone 16 and 17, 15 W for older', and Macworld adds that the Air is limited to 20 W. None gives the 22.5 W peak for the iPhone 16 and 16 Pro, the 15 W limit on the 17e, the 16e exclusion, or Apple's lower limits when an accessory is connected. MobileReviews Eh! has no per-model mapping and tested only an iPhone 17 Pro. Macworld already covers the Anker 'not for Tesla or Mercedes' line and says to check ESR's vent exclusion list, so the vent findings are only partly new. ESR's own help page says the OmniLock 'attaches securely to all air vent types'. A review page (Tiny Tech Box) quotes ESR as excluding round, bladeless, irregular and hidden vents, and iOS Hacker gives 10–32 mm wide, 1–4 mm thick blades. The two ESR statements disagree.
decides: This answers the follow-up question every ChatGPT chat ended on ('which iPhone do you have?'). A 25 W cooled mount reaches its full rating only on the 16 Plus, 16 Pro Max, 17, 17 Pro/Pro Max and 18 Pro/Pro Max. A 16 or 16 Pro tops out around 22 W, the Air at 20 W, and a 17e at 15 W, so a 17e owner gets nothing from paying for 25 W. 16e owners should skip every magnetic mount here, because the phone has no magnets and Anker lists it as not compatible. It also splits the Anker and ESR picks by car. Anker excludes Tesla, Mercedes-Benz cylindrical and Honda honeycomb vents, and needs no case or an Apple MagSafe case of 2.5 mm or less for 25 W. ESR needs bladed vents 10–32 mm wide and 1–4 mm thick, and a case under 2 mm.

findings.product: Anker Prime Wireless Car Charger AirCool (A2933)
